description: Observation from the fz-kdt.101 build (2026-08-31): jobs/transport.rs:141 (direct_surfaces) and :2094 (rendered) sort by ShapeId::as_u32 -- shape-interner mint order, the same hazard class fz-kdt.101 fixed for Ty ids but on a different interner. NO MEASURED LEAK: 00420/00183/range_map are byte-identical FIFO vs LIFO with these untouched, so either the sorted sets are singletons in practice or shapes intern in schedule-stable order on these drives. Fixing it needs a canonical ShapeId comparator (recursive over ShapeDescr, the order.rs cmp_ty pattern on the shape arena) which does not exist. Sequence: only worth building if a leak is ever demonstrated (LIFO-style perturbation moving canon through these two sorts) or if a shape-heavy fixture lands; until then this is a recorded hazard, not work.
title: ShapeId mint-order sorts in transport packaging: same hazard shape as fz-kdt.101, unproven leak, no canonical comparator exists
